cover.coreProposition: Asynchronous authoritative-cache reconciliation should bind each snapshot to both principal identity and causal generation, serialize participating mutation paths, reject stale publication and require positive completeness evidence before destructive cleanup, while modeling remote membership separately from local materialization readiness.
cover.visualMetaphor: A dated inventory seal blocks an obsolete wave before it can erase a set of carefully preserved physical artifacts
cover.semanticObject: A single authoritative inventory plate protecting materialized objects from an incoming stale layer
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with layered depth, teal and rust palette, one crisp inventory plate and a clearly deflected stale wave, no labels and strong thumbnail silhouette
